::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/payment_methods/{pm}"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |
| `pm` | `string` | **yes** | The payment method's id (pm_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | OUR id for the vaulted instrument. Not the gateway's — see reference_id. |
| `provider` | `string` | The payment provider that holds the card. |
| `type` | `string` | Instrument kind, e.g. card. |
| `brand` | `string` | The card brand, e.g. `visa`. |
| `last4` | `string` | The last four digits of the card number. |
| `exp_month` | `integer` | The card's expiry month (1-12). |
| `exp_year` | `integer` | The card's expiry year (four digits). |
| `status` | `string` | The payment method's status. |
| `role` | `string` | primary \| backup \| none. `none` = excluded from automatic collection. |
| `is_default` | `boolean` | Convenience for role === primary. |
| `gateway_account` | `string` | Gateway account that vaulted (and will charge) this method; null for legacy env-configured providers with no gateway_accounts row. |
| `gateway_account_label` | `string` | The label of the gateway account that holds this payment method. |
| `reference_id` | `string` | The GATEWAY's reference for the instrument, `<gateway customer id>/<gateway token id>`. Token-only for gateways with no customer object of their own (PayPal). Null when the gateway supplied no token — render nothing rather than substituting the pm_… id. |
| `instrument` | `object` | What the gateway knows about the instrument itself. Null when it reported none of it. A null FIELD inside means that one fact is unknown — in particular a null `issuer_country` is UNKNOWN, never 'not issued in India'. |
| `mandate` | `object` | The mandate this instrument was registered under, as the PROVIDER reports it. Null on a plain card-on-file with no mandate rail. A null `max_amount_minor` means the provider reported no ceiling — unknown, NOT unlimited. |
| `avs_check` | `object` | What the gateway said about the address / CVC when this instrument was vaulted or charged. Null means nothing was captured — distinct from `unchecked`, which is a real verdict a gateway can send. Stripe only today. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the payment method was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such payment method |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/payment_methods/pm_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
